title: SportsLiveInfo channel identity dictionary (sli.dictionary/1)
description: UK and Europe channels (plus optional owner-enabled world regions) from the public-domain iptv-org database: names, alternative names, feeds (regional/HD/+1) with broadcast areas, network, categories, website, closures and rebrands. Readers resolve a provider channel name within its market with market_key() and the published rules.

regions.description: Optional (1.4+). Owner opt-in world regions included beyond UK/Europe.

group_markets.description: Optional (1.4+). Multi-country markets where a leading country tag narrows the lookup (rules.country_tag).

country_tags.description: Optional (1.4+). Provider section tag -> ISO country.
